title: Kairos'Light
description:
SAVE EDMOND
Edmond is a lost fifty-year-old who missed his life. And on top of that, before ending his life, he forgot to set up an automatic reply on his mailbox. Unacceptable. Fortunately for him, and for you because otherwise there would be no game, Kairos will send him back to his past to change his destiny! WIN POGNON
Cross the street and find a passion job that doesn't pay in visibility in order to gain access to high-end vehicles, a suit, and eventually a castle. DEVELOP THE CITY
Edit the city because it's your PROJEEEET and you're going to make it WIN. RELEASE YOUR SKILLS
Unleash your #skills to #growth your #efficiency. #personaldevelopment BREAKING DOWN SLICES
Because why not. MEET YOUR NEIGHBORS
Meet Jamil the manly country boy with refined facial capillarity, Simon the LifeStyle influencer or Godefroy who will help you assert your social positioning. MAKE TIPS
Rummage through the garbage, collect 5 stones, 6 screws and 2 boards to make a whole series of furniture in one click (because it's a simulation, but it's mostly a video game first!).REPUSHES THE EXTRATERRENT QUENILS
Because always why not. ALTERNATIVE ENDINGS
Edmond guide for (non-exhaustive possibilities):
- Let him destroy capitalism
- Go to Mars and become Edmond Musk
- Let him be eaten by a dinosaur
- ...

In short Kairos'Light is : 
Projeeeets, inhabitants with particular whims, business that works at the moment and the energies of the cosmic Christ that makes cabins grow in the trees.
Kairos'Light, because why not.
A crazy and free adventure.
description_short: Change the future of Edmond, a desperate guy who failed his life. In this simulation, improve the town of Thésye, earn money, buy a castle, and collect cattails.
